title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Luke 23: the trial before Pilate and Herod, the release of Barabbas, the crucifixion and the burial by Joseph.

questions.text: What did they accuse Jesus of before Pilate?
questions.explanation: They accused him of perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.

answers.text: Breaking into the temple treasury and taking the money
Leading an armed revolt in the city against the governor
Refusing to appear before the council of the elders
Perverting the nation, forbidding taxes to Caesar and claiming to be a king

questions.text: What did Pilate say to the chief priests and the multitudes after questioning him?
questions.explanation: Pilate said, "I find no basis for a charge against this man."

answers.text: "I find no basis for a charge against this man"
"I will keep him in prison until the feast is over"

questions.text: To whom did Pilate send Jesus when he learned whose jurisdiction he was in?
questions.explanation: When Pilate found out that Jesus was in Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

questions.text: Whom did the crowd cry out to have released instead of Jesus?
questions.explanation: They all cried out together, "Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!"

questions.text: Whom did they grab to carry the cross after Jesus?
questions.explanation: As they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

answers.text: One of the daughters of Jerusalem

questions.text: What was the place called where they crucified him?
questions.explanation: When they came to the place that is called "The Skull", they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

questions.text: What was written in the inscription over him?
questions.explanation: An inscription was written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: "THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS."

answers.text: "THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS"

questions.text: What did Jesus answer the criminal who asked to be remembered in his Kingdom?
questions.explanation: Jesus said to him, "Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise."

answers.text: "You will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud"
"Today you will be with me in Paradise"
"Go in peace, your faith has saved you"

questions.text: What happened in the temple when the sun was darkened?
questions.explanation: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

answers.text: The veil of the temple was torn in two
The lamps in the temple went out
The temple doors were shut and sealed

questions.text: Who asked Pilate for Jesus' body and laid it in a tomb cut in stone?
questions.explanation: Joseph, a good and righteous man from Arimathaea who was a member of the council, went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body, then wrapped it in linen and laid it in a tomb cut in stone.

answers.text: The centurion who stood by the cross
Simon of Cyrene, who had carried the cross
The women who came with him from Galilee
Joseph, a member of the council, from Arimathaea
